data.title: How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Development Team? (2026 Guide)
data.html_title: How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Development Team?
data.html_description: Get transparent 2026 pricing for hiring a development team - from $20K MVPs to $1M+ enterprise builds. Includes rates by region, team type, and hidden costs.
data.description: There is no single price tag for building software. Ask five CTOs how much it costs to hire a development team, and you will get five different numbers - because cost is not a fact; it is a function of at least five variables: project complexity, developer location, team seniority, engagement model, and tech stack.
